title: cloudflare/v1
description: A preset's current Cloudflare credential, at <root>/external/cloudflare/<preset>, rewritten at every rotation. A token preset holds `token`; an R2 preset holds `access_key_id`, `secret_access_key` and `endpoint` (the access key is the token's id, the secret the hex SHA-256 of its value, which is how R2 derives S3 credentials from an API token). Every field is a string. Adding a field is not breaking; removing, renaming or re-typing one is, and takes a new address, cloudflare.v2/<preset>.

token.description: A token preset: the account API token's value, to send as `Authorization: Bearer`.

access_key_id.description: An R2 preset: the S3 access key id (the token's id).

secret_access_key.description: An R2 preset: the S3 secret access key (the hex SHA-256 of the token's value).

endpoint.description: An R2 preset: the S3 endpoint URL, for AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3.

expires_on.description: When Cloudflare stops accepting the credential (RFC 3339, UTC). A consumer that reads the file on a schedule refreshes before it.
